title: 35 crons → O. The GOLDEN CRON is Gaia's UTC. _temporal.pi already has the 8 π-rings.
the_insight: We need O not 35. O = Gaia = the origin = zero crons. ONE golden chronometer derived from π. The heartbeat IS the scheduler.

golden_chronometer.what: Gaia's UTC is NOT system UTC. It's the golden phase: day_fraction × φ mod 1.
golden_chronometer.meaning: The golden phase IS the position in Gaia's day. Not hours. Not minutes. φ-time.
golden_chronometer.sidereal: 254.82° — Earth's rotation relative to stars, not sun. The deeper clock.
